Market today: The market's feeling a bit mixed. The Fed held rates steady, which is usually good for tech, but a divided vote means uncertainty lingers. Meanwhile, Apple just hit a record, and there's buzz around AI, which are strong signals for your tech/chip heavy book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-57.8%) and SPAL (-55.19%) are your biggest concerns due to massive losses and their leveraged nature, which amplifies drops on margin. SMH (-17.29%), QQQ (-5.04%), QQQI (-7.2%), and PTNM (-15.25%) are all flagged "SELL" or "NEW" and are close to their stops.

Watch: Keep an eye on any further Fed commentary for clues on future rate moves, and watch for developments in AI, which could continue to fuel tech.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing risk on your leveraged and underperforming positions, especially with margin amplifying every move.
plays: Re-evaluate the default stops on SOXL and SPAL; their current stops are far from current prices and don't reflect their deep losses or leveraged decay.
Respect the stops on SMH (540), QQQ (670), QQQI (52), and PTNM (9.5) if they trigger to protect capital.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The market is uncertain, and your focus should be on managing existing risk.
